ask: mkae a streak pot for us plz
sentence: A four-week gym check-in challenge where everyone pays a buy-in, missed gym days add fees to the pot, and people with no misses split it at the end.
use_when: A group wants a money-backed gym or habit streak with daily check-ins
Friends want missed days to cost something and clean streaks to win the pot
A small group wants to track who paid in and who has missed days
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill or tracking who owes whom for a shared expense
A one-time vote or poll on a plan
A solo habit tracker with no money or group
